mapper.sql: biz29_account_id AS account_id , biz29_company_id AS company_id , biz29_corp_id AS corp_id , biz29_start_date AS start_date , biz29_bank_cd AS bank_cd , biz29_account_no AS account_no , biz29_account_nm AS account_nm , biz29_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id , biz29_note AS note , sys15_corp_nm AS corp_nm , f_cdnm('BankCode', biz29_bank_cd, biz29_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS bank_nm , ast01_class_tree_nm AS ast_class_tree_nm
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz29_account LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = biz29_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = biz29_ast_class_tree_id WHERE biz29_company_id = #{companyId} AND upper(concat(biz29_account_nm,sys15_corp_nm,ast01_class_tree_nm, biz29_note)) LIKE upper(#{searchText})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz29_account (biz29_account_id, biz29_company_id, biz29_corp_id, biz29_start_date, biz29_bank_cd, biz29_account_no, biz29_account_nm, biz29_ast_class_tree_id, biz29_note) VALUES (#{r.accountId}, #{companyId}, #{r.corpId}, #{r.startDate}, #{r.bankCd}, #{r.accountNo}, #{r.accountNm}, #{r.astClassTreeId}, #{r.note})
